thread:
sarah.ops: heads up - we're getting a spike of 5xxs and 504s out of us-central-az3 for hosted inference. Customer escalations inbound. any visibility? :rotating_light:

jay.sre: seeing it on dashboards too. 5xx rate up ~18% over baseline, 95th latency doubled. traces show bursts of gateway timeouts.

nia.neteng: just checked our flow logs, noticing >10% packet retransmit rate on egress toward transit peer in az3. possible microburst or qos shaping.

ryan-support: multiple customers reported timeouts and a billing alert from one tenant where retries ballooned token usage. opened a P1 with support. SLA page incoming.

maya-dev: i'm able to repro locally against hosted endpoint in us-central and set a looped request at 50 rps -> lots of 504 after a minute. attaching minimal curl repro: ```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"test"}' || echo "err:$i"; sleep 0.2; done
```

jay.sre: thanks — logs show the gateway returns 504 with upstream closed errors. stack traces point to connection reset between gateway and inference-frontends in az3.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1975308642 - us-central-az3 egress jitter causing gateway 5xxs. /assign @nia.neteng @jay.sre

sarah.ops: pinged carrier contacts, waiting on ack. tagging customers with incident link.

carrier-ops: acknowleged - seeing high packet loss between our egress POP and the cloud provider fabric for a subset of prefixes. Possible QoS degradation. we're investigating on transport. ETA unknown.

nia.neteng: running quick traceroutes from edge to peer: ```
traceroute -n 10.0.0.1
 1  10.10.0.1  0.3 ms
 2  192.0.2.5  1.2 ms  (-> peer)
 3  * * *
 4  203.0.113.9  8.9 ms
```
lots of * hops at the carrier handoff.

jay.sre: I pushed a temporary routing policy to steer new traffic to us-central-az1/az2 for hosted inference to reduce customer impact. can we confirm health of those zones?

maya-dev: az1 looks healthy. switching traffic reduces errors for my repro run. good short-term mitigation.

ryan-support: notified impacted customers: suggested workaround to pin to us-central-az1/az2 or enable client-side retries with exponential backoff. included sample retry headers.

nia.neteng: carrier reports intermittent BGP withdraws for a small ASN in our egress path. they are escalating to upstream transit. attach carrier debug: ```
BGP: withdrawn prefixes x.x.x.x/24 observed at 2026-04-12T16:02:13Z
TCP: retransmit spikes 15-25% on socket to peer 198.51.100.7
```

jay.sre: rolling deploy to reduce persistent connections in az3 frontends (lower keepalive) to avoid head-of-line blocking while carrier stabilizes. command I ran: ```bash
kubectl set env deployment/inference-frontends KEEPALIVE=15 -n hosted-us-central-az3
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: inference-frontends/us-central-az3 @jay.sre - rolling restart initiated.

carrier-ops: upstream confirmed a misconfigured QoS policy on transit leg - they are reverting change now. traffic should normalize in ~12-18 minutes.

sarah.ops: good. monitoring for recovery. please capture any persistent customer reports for follow-up.

maya-dev: after failover and keepalive tweak, error rate down to ~2%. latency still slightly elevated but within SLO.

ryan-support: note - one customer reported duplicate charges due to their retrying logic during the incident. support queue has ticket, billing notified to review idempotency key handling and credits.

jay.sre: filing post-incident notes: potential improvements - auto-steer based on packet-loss signals, stricter connection pooling limits per zone, add alert on egress retransmit rate.

incident-bot: Status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. INC-2026-1975308642 assigned to postmortem.

carrier-ops: QoS revert completed at 2026-04-12T16:21:45Z. packet loss dropped to <0.5%. apologies for the disruption.

nia.neteng: capturing pcap snippet and BGP update dumps for postmortem. saving to /var/log/incidents/1975308642/pcap and /var/log/incidents/1975308642/bgp-dumps.

ryan-support: customer-facing summary drafted. will send once PM review is done.

sarah.ops: great work team. follow-ups: postmortem, customer credits for affected tenants with billing anomalies, and a runbook update for auto-steer thresholds. closing channel once doc is live. :white_check_mark:
